headline: The sea is swimmable until 11:00 for the first time since race day - and nothing has synced since Friday night.
body:
Fourth drought. training.json is stamped **2 Oct 21:31** - **34.6 hours** old - and 3 Oct 07:50, 3 Oct 21:30 and today's 07:50 all passed without a push. Saturday has no file and no wellness row. That is the laptop, never the watch: wellness ran complete through all three earlier droughts. So what did you actually do yesterday? Gusts hit **80-87 km/h**, so it was indoors or nothing.

The window held, though. Today 06:00-11:00: gust **25 km/h**, **17 C**, open water reads **good** for the first time since race day. It shuts at 11:00 - midday is **27 C** on a 37 gust. That is the sea swim: **1,200-1,500 m at 2:20-2:35/100 m**, sighting every six strokes. Ignore heart rate in the water.

Not a hard one. HRV went **65 then 63 against a 69.1 mean** Thursday and Friday, and nothing newer has landed to clear that gate.

Tomorrow 06:00-11:00 is calmer still at a **19 gust** if today gets away. Wake the laptop. And the ankle - the run window is good too, but no answer has ever reached this file.
